description: This file defines a helper class 'Log' that acts as a wrapper around Android's native logging system, providing static methods and constants for logging at various levels and managing a chain of LogNode instances for log processing.

classes.name: Log
classes.description: Helper class for managing logging via a chain of LogNode objects, providing static methods for different log levels and log node management.

methods.name: getLogNode
methods.description: Returns the current LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: setLogNode
methods.description: Sets the LogNode to which log data will be sent.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Delegates a logging request to the current LogNode, if set.

methods.name: v
methods.description: Logs a message at VERBOSE level; overloaded for with/without Throwable.

methods.name: d
methods.description: Logs a message at DEBUG level; overloaded for with/without Throwable.

methods.name: i
methods.description: Logs a message at INFO level; overloaded for with/without Throwable.

methods.name: w
methods.description: Logs a message at WARN level; overloaded for with/without Throwable.

methods.name: e
methods.description: Logs a message at ERROR level; overloaded for with/without Throwable.

methods.name: wtf
methods.description: Logs at ASSERT level; overloaded for with/without Throwable.
